description: Figure 6 presents a pie chart titled “Distribution of data source in the AttrEval-Simulation,” showing how the combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets are divided across data-source categories, with 6 slices in total. The slices are labeled with percentages next to the chart: ENTITYQUEST is shown in blue at approximately 26.0%, HOTPOTQA is shown in red at approximately 24.2%, POPQA is shown in yellow/gold at approximately 21.6%, TRIVIAQA is shown in orange at approximately 22.7%, WEBQUESTIO is a small light-cyan slice at approximately 3.6%, and TREC is a very small green slice at approximately 1.9%. The chart uses direct text labels with percentages rather than a separate legend, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized.
